subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub accept the RFC-backed experimental Claw package and dedicated-feed contract, including its ordered four-PR rollout and deployment-gated compatibility boundary?
rationale: The patch is technically scoped around a new package family and external OpenClaw lifecycle contract; whether that contract should enter ClawHub is a product and compatibility decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor the gated stack
options.body: Approve the experimental Claw contract, retain the deployment gate, and review the four slices in dependency order after real hosted proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow or defer the contract
options.body: Keep the stack open while maintainers specify a smaller feed/API contract or wait for RFC resolution before accepting the new package family.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated stack
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental Claw contract, retain the deployment gate, and review the four slices in dependency order after real hosted proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the coordinated implementation stack and can provide the requested runtime evidence, though final contract sponsorship requires a repository decision-maker.
